Create a polished desktop website hero mockup as a single wide landscape image, approximately 1536x1024, crisp exact English text, no browser chrome, no instructional annotations. A useful free self-guided walking map is the offer (reciprocity), not a real commercial claim. Same exact text in all examples:
small wordmark: "FIRST DETOUR"
small eyebrow: "A SMALL ADVENTURE STARTS HERE"
large headline split as needed: "Find a new way through your city."
supporting copy: "Take a different turn with a free neighborhood walking map."
primary CTA button: "Get the free map"
small reassurance below button: "PDF download. No email required."
No other text, no testimonials, no extra CTAs. Keep copy in generous left half of composition, illustration/photo occupying right half. Human adult on right holds a folded map and turns head and gaze left inward toward the headline. Exact CTA must be completely readable and prominent with strong contrast. Image must be a complete usable hero layout with professional typography, enough whitespace, not a standalone picture. All people are fictional. Style: Swiss/International Typographic Style-inspired modernist layout, strict grid, flush-left black grotesk sans-serif typography, warm ivory background, disciplined dark-forest-green rectangular CTA with white lettering, small orange rule. Right image: natural editorial-style photorealistic adult woman with short curly dark hair wearing a terracotta jacket, holding a folded city map on a textured city street in daylight. Medium shot, face visible, looking inward left. Rectangular photo crop aligned to the grid. Realistic skin and ordinary clothing. This is AI-generated photographic imagery, not documentary evidence. Restrained, confident, functional.
